text: 【外国企业对特定二次圆柱形电池、电池组件及包含该组件的产品提起337调查申请】据中国贸易救济信息网消息，2026年7月21日，韩国LGEnergySolutionLtd.、美国LGEnergySolutionArizona,Inc.根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，主张对美出口、在美进口及销售的特定二次圆柱形电池、电池组件及包含该组件的产品违反了美国337条款。
text_en: Foreign Company Files Section 337 Investigation Application on Certain Rechargeable Cylindrical Batteries, Battery Components, and Products Containing the Same: According to the China Trade Remedy Information Network, on July 21, 2026, LG Energy Solution Ltd. of South Korea and LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. of the US filed a petition with the US International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the US Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain rechargeable cylindrical batteries, battery components, and products containing the same exported to, imported into, or sold in the US violate Section 337.
